name: legacy-modernization
description: [Limited availability] Modernize legacy applications onto OutSystems on a live ODC tenant: extract the requirements from legacy sources (/extract-requirements), build and verify the replacement app (/workflow-legacy-app), the /outsystems-app-generation light path, the migration close-out documents, the test evidence pack, and the planner, designer, developer, reviewer, tester and reporter roles. Uses the outsystems plugin's MCP server and its Mentor build skills.
